title: Research: the seven separated A2 sites transfer to the PR3945 words
body:
## Contribution

`research/separated-a2-pr3945-transfer` — a second, distinct finite result for the same chooser seed `05f92898273de33149bc662a2b87104d` (card `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision 7). **No new κ. The selected record is not edited.**

This is not the consecutive A1858 climb in PR #5195. [PR #4019](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4019) certified seven separated sites only on the older PR3734 providers and left later-word applicability open.

## Established result

On both frozen PR3945 words, the seven separated A2 sites occur at the published indices, and contracting them removes seven forward ADDs and five cleanup ADDs without changing the recursive frame histogram.

The same seven/five saving and an unchanged `{1:2440,2:725,3:224,4:102,5:20,8:8}` histogram reproduce on both PR3734 words. Both PR3945 words stay at `{1:2482,2:712,3:218,4:109,5:20,8:8}`. Each triple shares a frame, stays inside one warp segment, and has no intervening use of its three registers. Removing a different gate of the triple fails the rational map. Forgetting to remap the B warp cuts fails frame containment.

## Limits

No paid frame transition is removed. Native, owner, precision, stock and tape are not priced. This is not a search for further sites. `make frontier4470-verify` was not run. Replay passed on Python 3.12: `PASS_SEPARATED_A2_PR3945_TRANSFER` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
